findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Button sets disabled and type=button even when render swaps in a non-button element, so a disabled or loading link-styled Button still navigates.
findings.fix: When render targets a non-button element, emit aria-disabled and tabIndex handling instead of disabled, omit type, and block activation (Base UI nativeButton pattern); add render-as-anchor and ref tests.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Entering loading sets native disabled, so a keyboard user who activates the button loses focus to the document body.
findings.fix: Keep a loading button focusable (aria-disabled plus prevented activation, like Base UI focusableWhenDisabled) and test that focus stays on it.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: No truncation strategy for long or translated labels: nowrap with no overflow handling, and no long/CJK/RTL story.
findings.fix: Add overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis on .a63-Button-label text (or document wrapping), plus a long-label/CJK/RTL story with a baseline.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: No forced-colors handling or ForcedColors story; data-pressed relies on fill only.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule for [data-pressed]/[aria-pressed] (Highlight) and a ForcedColors story like toggle's.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: CLI page for button lacks the Contract, Related and Examples sections other components get, and omits tile, icon-* sizes and indicator props.
findings.fix: Append the generated contract/related/examples sections after the hand-written body and list indicator/indicatorLabel.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Hover and focus-visible states have no baseline for any subject in this batch.
findings.fix: Add pseudo-state captures (storybook-addon-pseudo-states or forced data attributes) for hover and focus-visible in each States story.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Grouped buttons lose the 44px touch target: overflow:hidden on members (and overflow-x:auto on the root) clips Button's ::before hit area, leaving 32px cells on touch.
findings.fix: Move the clip to the label (as Toggle did) and raise --button-group-height to the min-target under input=touch, or otherwise guarantee the 44px floor; add a touch endpoint assertion.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Pressed members (aria-pressed/data-pressed) are not distinguishable in forced-colors mode.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule mapping pressed members to Highlight/HighlightText, plus a ForcedColors story.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Group size only sets cell height; member font and padding stay at the member's own size, so size='xs' gives 24px cells with md text.
findings.fix: Have the group size drive member padding/font (or document that members must take the matching size).

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Dead public API: ButtonGroupProvider/useButtonGroupContext are exported as stable but nothing reads the context; root lacks render and lets props override data-slot/role.
findings.fix: Stop exporting the context (or use it); put data-slot/role after the spread and add render for parity with ButtonGroupText.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Themes baseline puts text labels in an icon-sm group, so the On/Off/Off cells look crammed.
findings.fix: Use size='sm' (text) or real icons in that row and re-baseline.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Toggle shows no theme archetype in aqua or retro: both rows look like modern, though the contract lists gloss and shadow token slots.
findings.fix: YZ to confirm whether aqua/retro toggles should carry gloss/bevel like Button and ToggleGroup; then wire the toggle.gloss/shadow slots per theme.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: CLI answer has no code example and generic form guidance (errors, invalid state) that does not apply to Toggle.
findings.fix: Add a usage example and component-specific guidance in component-catalog.ts; drop the form boilerplate for non-field controls.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Long toggle labels are clipped with no ellipsis (nowrap + overflow:hidden on content).
findings.fix: Add text-overflow:ellipsis on the content text or allow wrapping, and a long-label story.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: ToggleGroup exposes size and tone props that its contract does not list, so the CLI never surfaces them; selectionModes maps to a boolean multiple prop.
findings.fix: Add sizes and tones (shared with toggle) to toggle-group.json and document the selectionModes -> multiple mapping.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: No APG pattern contract binds toggle, toggle-group or button; keyboard behaviour is covered only by unit tests.
findings.fix: Add a button (toggle) and toolbar/radio-like pattern contract in ui-foundation/src/a11y and bind these stories.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The contract's 'copied' state has no story or baseline, and the failure state is not designed.
findings.fix: Add a Copied story (CopyButtonFeedback copied, icon-only and labelled) with a baseline, and a failure test.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: Visible 'Copied!' and the failure toast text are hardcoded English with no prop.
findings.fix: Add copiedText and errorMessage props (and use copiedLabel for the visible label) so products can localise.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: CLI contract table prints iconSizes and labelSizes as all ten sizes, and the page has no code example.
findings.fix: Fix the CLI renderer for defaultIconSize/defaultLabelSize (they are defaults, not axes) and add an example.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The clipboard failure path is never exercised in tests.
findings.fix: Add a test where writeText rejects and assert the error toast and that copied stays false.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: No onCopy/onError callback; consumers cannot react to the outcome.
findings.fix: Add onCopy(value) and onCopyError(error) props.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: '(opens in new tab)' is hardcoded English in the accessible name with no prop.
findings.fix: Add an externalLabel prop (default '(opens in new tab)').

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: Hover exists in the recipe but not the contract, and focus-visible (a required state) has no baseline.
findings.fix: Add hover to the contract and baseline hover/focus-visible.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: No touch or phone evidence and no target floor for standalone links.
findings.fix: Add an Endpoints story with touch, and a min-block-size/padding floor when the link is not inline.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: CLI page has no code example of the router render pattern and carries unrelated boilerplate; no Playground story.
findings.fix: Add a render={<RouterLink/>} example and a Playground; make guidance specific.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: The link looks the same in every theme, terminal does not take its mono face, the themes matrix is unlabelled, and the internal glyph is an eye.
findings.fix: YZ to decide the per-theme link treatment and the internal-destination glyph; label the matrix rows.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: DestinationIndicator takes only className and kind: no prop spread, no ref.
findings.fix: Accept ComponentProps<'span'> and spread them.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: active is controlled-only: no defaultActive or onActiveChange, unlike Toggle; the tile layout duplicates Button size='tile' behind a stale comment.
findings.fix: Add defaultActive/onActiveChange (or build on Base UI Toggle) and reuse Button size='tile'; update the comment.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: In dark modes the active tile's icon (action-primary on a 15% primary tint) reads dimmer than the inactive icon.
findings.fix: Use the accent text token (e.g. --a63-text-accent) for the active foreground and declare the pair in the contrast test.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: Long or translated labels do not wrap or truncate inside the tile (inherited nowrap).
findings.fix: Set white-space:normal with line clamp or ellipsis on .a63-PanelSettingButton-label and add a long-label story.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: CLI page has no example and generic form guidance (errors, invalid state).
findings.fix: Add an example and component-specific guidance.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: Only three render tests; no activation, keyboard or conformance coverage.
findings.fix: Add click/Space toggling and disabled tests.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: KbdGroup renders a div, so the documented use inside running text is invalid nesting (hydration warning).
findings.fix: Render KbdGroup as a <kbd> (or <span>), as nested <kbd> is valid HTML.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: The tooltip-inverted cap and its dark-mode branch have no story or baseline; the branch is listed debt (mode-branch and surface-page-as-text in craft-baseline.json).
findings.fix: Read the tooltip foreground token instead of branching on mode, and add a Kbd-in-Tooltip story.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: kbd.mdx names --a63-control-radius but the recipe uses --radius-sm and --a63-marker-shadow.
findings.fix: Update the tokens line.
